title: Masu Kula da Girbin Sirri
intro: A cikin ƙasa mai yawan ciyayi, wasu mutane sun yi wani shiri na sirri a cikin duhu. Sun kasance suna da manufa ɗaya, amma manufarsu ba ta da adalci. Ba su san cewa wata karkatacciyar hanya ta Allah tana jiran su ba yayin da suke barci.
clues: Mun yanke shawara mai ƙarfi, muna tunanin shirinmu ba shi da aibi.
Mun yi niyyar fita da wuri, kafin wasu ma su yi ta ihu.
Mun kafa wani fili mai albarka, muna da yakinin wadatar da muke da ita.
Yayin da muka isa inda muke, muka same shi babu kowa, don haka muka yi tunanin mun ɓace.
Sai muka fahimci cewa lallai wurinmu ne, sai muka yi kuka cikin damuwa, muna zargin junanmu da rashin da muka yi.
Mun rantse a safiyar nan cewa za mu ware talakawa daga girbinmu, amma azabar Allah ta zo mana yayin da muke barci, ta mayar da gonarmu ta zama kango.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
